notes.title: DOWNFALLEN is out on Steam!
notes.notes:
DOWNFALLEN, which was previously submitted to [url=https://1chicken.com/]1Chicken Game Jam[/url] 2022, has come to Steam as an extended cut including new scenes with enhanced narrative.

The Steam release of DOWNFALLEN revives every originally planned contents that were cut out during the production due to the short game jam deadline. The game is still available to play for free, or you can purchase it for $0.99 if you prefer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153920/DOWNFALLEN/

The build previously submitted to Game Jam is also included in this Steam release. If you're interested, check out what's different with the new one! (Please note that the game jam build requires a 64-bit processor and operating system)

You can access the build as follows.

[olist][*] Right-click on the game in your library
[*] Click "Properties..."
[*] Go to "Betas" tab
[*] Under the "Select the beta you would like to opt into:" drop-down menu, select "oldversion".
[*] Close the window and wait for the file to update before launching the game.[/olist]


Hope you enjoy the game. Thank you!
